_doc: Adversarial routing set: cross-category traps, negation, idioms, crisis, code-switching, romanized scripts, no-signal inputs. Expectations encode the correct behaviour, written before fixing the engine.

cases.text: My landlord won't let me cook in my apartment and we have no food.
cases._why: housing words must not beat an explicit lack of food

cases.text: I have a place to live but we can't afford groceries this week.
cases._why: 'have a place to live' is not a housing need

cases.text: We're not homeless, we just need food for the kids.

cases._why: 'at home' is a location, not a housing need
